question: How many seconds will a boy take to run one complete round around a square field of side 20 metres, if he runs at a speed of 9 km/hr?3703
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance to run = Perimeter of the square = 4 × 20 = 80 m.

Speed of the boy = 9 km/hr = 9 × (5 ÷ 18) = 2.5 m/s.

Time required = Distance ÷ Speed = 80 ÷ 2.5 = 32 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 32 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Side of the square field = 20 m

Speed of the boy = 9 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of a square = 4 × Side

Speed in m/s = Speed in km/hr × (5 ÷ 18)

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion for Speed

To convert speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply the value by (5 ÷ 18). Conversely, to convert from m/s to km/hr, multiply by (18 ÷ 5).

Perimeter of Basic Shapes

Perimeter of a Square = 4 × side. Perimeter of a Rectangle = 2 × (length + breadth). Circumference of a Circle = 2 × π × radius.

Time, Speed and Distance

The foundational relationship is Distance = Speed × Time. For computing average speed over multiple segments, always use Total Distance ÷ Total Time.
